readme.run: Denoise a diffusion MRI series with Patch2Self and write the derivatives
notes: Runs the web app's Patch2Self (the same dwidenoise.wasm WebAssembly module,
a port of DIPY 1.12.1 version 1, patch radius 0, OLS) and writes the denoised
image. The .bval (required), .bvec and .json beside the image with the same
name are passed through under the output's name; --bval, --bvec and --json
name others. --threads N sets the worker threads (default: one per core);
the output is the same for any number. Add --help for every setting.
No network connection is required. Input is NIfTI only: convert DICOM with
dcm2niix first, or use the web app.
Cite Fadnavis S, Batson J, Garyfallidis E. Patch2Self: Denoising Diffusion
MRI with Self-Supervised Learning. NeurIPS 2020, and DIPY: Garyfallidis E
